sentences.text: Leanne Marsh (S2) is present for a social care needs assessment review with Social Worker Angela Okafor (S1).
Leanne Marsh (S2) lives with her mum at home.
Leanne Marsh's mum has bad knees.
Leanne Marsh (S2) helps her mum with hoovering.
Leanne Marsh (S2) is currently traveling to the centre via a minibus driven by Dave.
Leanne Marsh (S2) is undertaking travel training to get the bus on her own to town.
Leanne Marsh (S2) likes doing art, specifically a big painting of her cat named Biscuit.
Leanne Marsh (S2) likes cooking on Mondays.
Leanne Marsh (S2) likes going to the disco on Fridays.
Leanne Marsh (S2) reported that Dave touched her on her chest while she was getting off the minibus outside her house.
Leanne Marsh (S2) reported that Dave touched her between her legs over her trousers.
Leanne Marsh (S2) reported that Dave kissed her on her mouth.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated that Dave told her the incidents were 'our secret' and not to tell her mum.
Leanne Marsh (S2) reported that Dave touched her every week when she was the last person on the bus.
Leanne Marsh (S2) reported that the abuse started after her birthday in August.
Leanne Marsh (S2) denied that any other staff at Brookside had touched her like that.
Leanne Marsh (S2) denied that she was in trouble.
Leanne Marsh (S2) expressed uncertainty about whether she would be in trouble ('Am I in trouble?').
Leanne Marsh (S2) requested that the social worker talk to her mum.
Leanne Marsh (S2) stated she would prefer a taxi for transport instead of her mum driving.
Leanne Marsh's mum cannot drive due to her knees.
Leanne Marsh (S2) expressed a wish to continue with art.
Social Worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to ring the safeguarding team and the police today.
Social Worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to talk to Joanne, the centre manager, to arrange a taxi from tomorrow, Wednesday.
Social Worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to visit Leanne Marsh's house tomorrow at 4 o'clock to tell her mum together.
Leanne Marsh (S2) requested that her cat, Biscuit, be present at the visit.
Social Worker Angela Okafor (S1) agreed to ask Sue to set up two practice bus trips into town in December.
